content:
nisha_g: Quick question  
Trying to move an IC from Senior PM -> Staff PM (director approved) effective 2025-06-01. They're currently on an international payroll (UK). What extra steps for cross-border comp and title changes? Also manager wants limited retro if needed.

lina_hr: Congrats on the approval! International moves require a couple extra items: 1) confirm local employment law for retro pay with Legal, 2) Finance must confirm payroll partner cutoffs and currency conversion, 3) we need a local HR备案 (record) entry in our global HRIS. For UK specifically, include the employee's National Insurance number on the packet.

juan_finance: For UK payroll: payroll partner needs final approved packet by 2025-05-09 to process a 2025-06-01 effective date without complicated FX adjustments. If submitted later we can still do backpay but FX reconciliation may add a week to the timeline. Also confirm which budget code (GBP vs USD) to charge.

michael_payroll: Echo Juan. Note: if manager insists on "limited retro" that's a policy discussion. Payroll will calculate retro from effective date if approval is after partner cutoff. We can request a manual exception but that requires Finance + Legal sign-off to ensure local compliance.

nisha_g: Understood. How about equity/grant paperwork? Does level change trigger refresh or repricing?

lina_hr: Title change itself doesn't auto-trigger new grants. If manager requests a promotion grant or repricing, submit a separate Equity Recommendation form; Compensation will review. If you want the grant to align with effective date, route the equity form at the same time as Role Change packet and note the intended grant date.

juan_finance: If Equity is approved and is in GBP-denominated plan for UK employees, coordinate with Compensation and Payroll early. Equity grants often have their own processing timeline (3-4 weeks).

nisha_g: One more: manager asked whether this is a "leveling exception" (e.g., expedite without panel) because the candidate has outside counteroffer. Any tips on documentation to speed up Comp review?

lina_hr: To request an expedited exception include: concrete counteroffer evidence (email/PDF), 3 bullet manager rationale focused on role impact, and market comp data if available. Tag people-ops@redwood and comp-review@redwood in the packet comments. We will triage and decide if an off-cycle comp panel or director-level signoff is required.

michael_payroll: Practical note: if you want no retro and expedited processing, get director + finance approvals in email before submitting portal packet and attach them. That increases chance payroll partner acceptance before cutoff.

nisha_g: Thanks. I'll assemble: Role Change packet + Finance cost code + director email + counteroffer proof + Equity request (if manager wants). Will ping when submitted.

people-ops-bot: Quick checklist: Required Role Change fields: employee name, employee ID, current title, new title, proposed base, effective date, manager rationale, director signoff, local payroll ID (for international), budget code. Links: HR portal 
https://hr.redwood.internal/role-change, Equity form 
https://comp.redwood.internal/equity-request, Payroll deadlines 
https://payroll.redwood.internal/deadlines.
